reason: Integrates the installed Claude Code CLI as an external LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness, including streamed responses and translated tool calls while leaving tool execution to the harness.

summaries.zh: 将已安装的 Claude Code CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为可提供流式响应和工具调用的外部语言模型提供方。
summaries.en: Connects an installed Claude Code CLI to DeepSeek Harness as an external language-model provider with streamed responses and translated tool calls.

capabilities: launches the installed Claude Code CLI as a subprocess
sends harness prompts and history to the CLI-backed model
streams model output back to the harness
exposes harness tool schemas through an MCP bridge without executing the tools itself
